title: theDAW
description: All-in-one AI music studio by GANTASMO. Stable Audio 3 and Magenta RealTime 2 generation, Chimera v2 multi-track fusion, Demucs stems, MIDI, notation and SCORE play-along, the NodeF.I. node editor, DJ, VJ and Sway Perform rigs, DAW project import, VST3 and .gan plugins, the Underfit LoRA trainer, and a RAG-backed in-app assistant.
